policy: Report-only after commit; no corpus/ledger/credit rewrite. This is separate from mechanical identity/coverage statistics.

issues.cause: A PowerShell-to-Python pipe used to insert one Korean/Japanese pair encoded the Unicode literals as question marks. The author reviewed the intended insertion instead of the serialized pair before commit.
issues.impact: One added paper-exchange sentence and its translation are corrupted; the intended explicit exchange therefore is missing. Existing Korean sentences remain preserved.
issues.mechanical_interpretation: The corrupted span is punctuation rather than an unknown content word under the existing lexical denominator, so its acceptance does not establish correct language quality. No intro/exposure credit arose from that span.
issues.resolution: Committed historical text stays frozen. Later candidate files use Unicode-preserving apply_patch; post-mechanical author review reads serialized pairs. Propose future corpus repair in a separate authorized version, not during this frozen trial.
